Trump Downplays Iran Conflict, Threatens Nuclear Site Strike

U.S. President Donald Trump described the conflict with Iran as "small potatoes" and suggested the U.S. might "hit" Iran's heavily fortified underground nuclear site "very soon." He also backed Vice President Vance's remark that the situation was "not a war." Trump made these statements on Friday, issuing a fresh warning to Iran. One report noted Trump compared U.S. deaths in the conflict to those in the Vietnam War. The coverage also mentions a looming question regarding China and Iran.
